seoTitle: Which Invincible Character Are You? Invincible Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Invincible test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Mark, Omni-Man, Debbie, Atom Eve, Allen, Cecil or Robot — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the young hero trying to live up to an impossible legacy, the grounded one holding everyone together, or the one who's always three steps ahead? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle family, pressure and secrets, and find out which Invincible character you are. Think, Mark!

characters.name: Mark Grayson
characters.title: The Determined Young Hero
characters.summary: Good-hearted, stubborn and determined to do the right thing — even when it costs you everything.
description: Like Mark, you're trying to live up to a huge legacy. He's the son of the most powerful hero on Earth, and he's still figuring out what kind of hero he wants to be.
You make mistakes, and you get knocked down — hard. But you always get back up.
Above all, you believe in protecting people, and you refuse to become the thing you're fighting.
characters.flaw: You're stubborn, and you try to carry everything on your own.
characters.signature: A blue-and-yellow suit and a black eye he's still recovering from.
characters.clashReason: they'd stick to their morals even when it makes things harder

characters.name: Omni-Man
characters.title: The Powerful Enigma
characters.summary: Commanding, confident and hiding a lot beneath the surface. You believe you know what's best — for everyone.
description: Like Nolan Grayson, you're powerful and you know it. He's the most respected hero on the planet — with a secret mission nobody suspected.
You're used to being right. You think in the long term, and you'll make brutal decisions for what you believe is the bigger picture.
But even you can change. Nolan's time on Earth made him question everything he was raised to believe.
characters.flaw: Your pride and your certainty make you capable of terrible things.
characters.signature: A cape, a moustache and "Think, Mark!"

characters.name: Debbie Grayson
characters.title: The Unbreakable Heart
characters.summary: Strong, grounded and far tougher than any superhero. You hold your family together when the world falls apart.
description: Like Debbie, you're the real strength in the family. She's human, surrounded by people with superpowers — and she's often the bravest of them all.
You've been through heartbreak and betrayal, and you keep going.
You love fiercely, and you're the voice of reason when everyone else is flying off the handle.
characters.flaw: You bottle up pain until it overflows.
characters.signature: A glass of wine, a sharp question and a steady hand on her son's shoulder.
characters.clashReason: they'd see straight through your lies

characters.name: Atom Eve
characters.title: The Principled Powerhouse
characters.summary: Smart, independent and determined to do real good. You don't need a team or a title to change the world.
description: Like Eve, you think bigger than punching villains. She walked away from the typical superhero life to use her powers to actually help people.
You're independent and confident. You don't wait for permission.
You're also a loyal friend, and the person others lean on when things get hard.
characters.flaw: You hold back what you really feel.
characters.signature: A pink glow and a plan to fix the problem at its root.
characters.clashReason: they'd do things their own way, never yours

characters.name: Allen the Alien
characters.title: The Cheerful Powerhouse
characters.summary: Friendly, upbeat and much stronger than you look. You make friends everywhere you go.
description: Like Allen, you're cheerful even when things are bleak. He's one of the friendliest characters in the universe — and one of the toughest.
You keep getting stronger. Allen doesn't quit, no matter how many times he's beaten.
You're loyal to your friends and to the bigger cause, and your optimism keeps others going.
characters.signature: One big eye, a big smile and a very friendly wave.
characters.clashReason: they'd be far too cheerful for you

characters.name: Cecil Stedman
characters.title: The Pragmatic Operator
characters.summary: Calculating, prepared and willing to make the hard calls. You've always got a contingency plan — for everyone.
description: Like Cecil, you run things from behind the scenes. He heads the government agency that keeps tabs on Earth's superheroes.
You're pragmatic to the point of ruthlessness. You'll make deals with people you don't like if it keeps the world safe.
You're rarely surprised, because you've already planned for almost everything.
characters.flaw: You treat people like pieces on a board.
characters.signature: A suit, a teleporter on standby and a backup plan for the backup plan.
characters.clashReason: they'd work with anyone — even the bad guys — to get it done

characters.name: Robot
characters.title: The Calculating Genius
characters.summary: Brilliant, logical and always thinking long-term. You see the most efficient solution — and you don't always tell people what it is.
description: Like Robot, you're a genius strategist. He leads the Guardians of the Globe with cold, precise logic.
You're more than people think. Robot has secrets about who — and what — he really is.
You believe you know the best way to fix the world, and you're willing to take control to do it.
characters.flaw: You think the ends justify the means.
characters.signature: A calm voice, a tactical plan and a secret he's kept for years.

questions.text: Someone in your group project isn't pulling their weight. You...

options.text: Do their part as well as yours, even if it means staying up all night
Calmly explain what happens if they don't
Reassign everything into the most efficient setup
Cheer them on. Everyone's got it in them!

questions.text: Someone tells you you're wrong, in front of everyone. You...

options.text: Insist you're right, and explain it again. Slower
Ask the one question that makes the room go quiet
Shrug. You'll prove it by doing it
Argue back, even if you're not totally sure
Sleep in, eat everything in the fridge, then see your friends
Volunteer somewhere. Sitting around feels wrong
Work on a project in your room. Alone
A glass of wine, a novel and nobody needing you

questions.text: You lose badly at something you care about. You...

options.text: Take it hard. Then get back up
Train until you're twice as strong, then go again
Refuse to accept it
Work out exactly what went wrong

questions.text: A friend fails at something they worked really hard for. You...

options.text: Make them a cup of tea and ask what really happened
Show up without being asked
Tell them they're amazing, loudly and often
Tell them to toughen up and try again

questions.text: You join a sport or club. You pick...

options.text: Anything with a team. The more friends the better
Honestly, none. You're too busy working
Chess. It's a sport if you do it right
Climbing. You like seeing how high you can go

questions.text: Someone you dislike offers a deal that would help everyone. You...

options.text: Take it. You don't have to like them
Refuse. You don't work with people like that
Agree — and quietly plan your way out of it
Shake on it. Maybe you'll end up friends

questions.text: You get the kind of news that changes everything. You...

options.text: Pour a drink and let yourself fall apart, just for one night
Stay calm and move straight to plan B
Go quiet and throw yourself into work
Decide what happens next. Fast

questions.text: The subject of kids following in their parents' footsteps comes up. You think...

options.text: Kids should carry on what their parents built
Following them is fine — as long as you do it your own way
Everyone should walk their own path
Whatever makes them happy. That's all that matters

questions.text: You find out a family member has lied to you for years. You...

options.text: Confront them. Loudly
Pack a bag, then decide whether to use it
Say nothing, and quietly check what else they've lied about
Let it go. You have secrets of your own

questions.text: You're a superhero. A villain you've just beaten begs for mercy and swears they'll change. They've hurt people before. You...

options.text: Let them go. Everyone deserves a chance
Offer them a job. Skills like that shouldn't go to waste
End it. They'll only do it again
Lock them up somewhere only you control

questions.text: You have superpowers. A government agency offers you money and backup to fight for them — but they decide where you go. You...

options.text: Refuse. You'll help people your own way
Sign up. Teamwork!
Laugh. They should be working for you
Ask what happens to your family if you say no
